query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            (SELECT 1 FROM bookable_appointments ba
            JOIN LATERAL (
              SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) schema_id, begins
              FROM bookable_schema_assignments
              WHERE asset_id = ba.asset_id
                AND begins <= lower(ba.during)
              ORDER BY asset_id, begins DESC
            ) bsa ON true
            WHERE schema_id = $1)
        ) AS "existing: bool"
